# Al-Arabia Subhania Hafizia Madrasah

> Official website of Al-Arabia Subhania Hafizia Madrasah — an Islamic educational institution offering Hifz and Kitab education, with online admissions, notices, results, donations, and more.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the Madrasah, latest notices, and quick links.
- [About](/about): History, mission, vision, and leadership of the Madrasah.
- [Contact](/contact): Address, phone, email, and location map.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photos of campus, events, and activities.
- [Notices](/notices): Official announcements and circulars.
- [Posts](/posts): News, articles, and updates.
- [Admission](/admission): Online admission application.
- [Admission Tests](/admission-tests): Public admission test information.
- [Results](/result): Student result lookup.
- [Donation](/donation): Support the Madrasah through donations.
- [Zakat & Fitra](/zakat-fitra): Zakat and Fitra calculator and information.
- [Quran](/quran): Read the Holy Quran with translations and recitation.

## Optional

- [Complaints](/complaints): Submit and track complaints.
